parsed.answer: Yes, you do. NW1001 was an Express shipment promised by Nov 3 and delivered on Nov 5, so it was late. Late Express shipments get a 100% credit of the shipping fee. The credit is applied to your account within 7 days. It is account credit only and isn't paid out in cash. One exception: delays caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address supplied by the customer aren't eligible. I don't see anything in your shipment data about either of those.
